selective_risk_definition: prediction errors among accepted samples / accepted samples
aurc_definition: mean empirical selective risk over all nonzero prefix coverage levels after sorting samples from lowest to highest predicted risk
coverage_at_risk_definition: maximum empirical calibration-holdout coverage whose selective risk is <= epsilon
threshold_transfer_policy: freeze calibration-derived thresholds and apply unchanged to IID and later shifted datasets
tie_handling: stable mergesort; threshold acceptance uses <=; later transferred datasets may therefore have different coverage when scores tie
